edges.description: PDGF-BB secretion activates PDGFR-beta on tumor cells
PDGFR activation drives continuous cell division
Dermal proliferation produces indurated plaques and protuberant skin nodules.
Deep honeycomb infiltration into the subcutis forms a poorly circumscribed soft tissue mass.

nodes.description: Tumor cells secrete mature PDGF-BB which binds to PDGFR-beta on the same or neighboring dermal fibroblastic tumor cells, creating an autocrine and paracrine growth loop. PDGFR-beta tyrosine kinase activation drives proliferation through downstream MAPK and PI3K pathways and can be inhibited by imatinib.

biological_processes: platelet-derived growth factor receptor signaling pathway

evidence.snippet: The demonstration of the oncogenic power of the translocation COL1A1-PDGFB in DFSP has allowed the successful introduction of drug therapy with antagonists of the PDGFB receptor for metastatic or locally advanced cases.

evidence.reference_title: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans COL1A1-PDGFB fusion is identified in virtually all dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans cases when investigated by newly developed multiplex reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction and fluorescence in situ hybridization assays.
evidence.snippet: fusion of exon 2 of PDGFB to various exons of the COL1A1 gene.

nodes.description: The t(17;22)(q22;q13) translocation or supernumerary ring chromosomes containing material from chromosomes 17 and 22 fuse the COL1A1 gene to exon 2 of PDGFB. This places PDGFB under control of the highly active COL1A1 promoter in dermal fibroblasts, resulting in constitutive expression of a functional PDGF-BB growth factor.

nodes.description: Fibrosarcomatous transformation occurs in a subset of DFSP cases and is associated with higher histologic grade, increased local recurrence, and elevated metastatic potential.

evidence.reference_title: Metastatic Fibrosarcomatous Transformation of Dermatofibrosarcoma Protuberans With Lung Metastasis: A Case Report.
evidence.snippet: In this study, we report a case of DFSP with fibrosarcomatous transformation, a rare but well-known phenomenon encountered in DFSP that is correlated with an increased risk of adverse outcomes in patients with DFSP.

evidence.reference_title: Rare Variants of Dermatofibrosarcoma Protuberans: Clinical, Histologic, and Molecular Features and Diagnostic Pitfalls
evidence.snippet: Only the fibrosarcomatous variant has been shown to differ significantly from classic DFSP in terms of clinical outcome; fibrosarcomatous DFSP has been shown to be associated with a greater risk of local recurrence and metastatic potential than classic DFSP.

nodes.description: Imatinib mesylate, a PDGFR inhibitor, is highly effective for unresectable or metastatic DFSP. Response rates exceed 50%. Imatinib may also be used as neoadjuvant therapy to shrink tumors before surgery. Fibrosarcomatous transformation may confer imatinib resistance.

evidence.snippet: Imatinib is clinically active against both localized and metastatic DFSP with chromosomal translocations; however, cases without fusion genes may not respond to imatinib

evidence.snippet: Its genetic background is a reciprocal translocation t(17;22)(q22;q13) that produces COL1A1-PDGFB gene fusion.

nodes.description: A slow-growing dermal plaque or nodule that progressively enlarges over months to years. The tumor often has a protuberant or multinodular surface and may be skin-colored, red-brown, or violaceous.

evidence.snippet: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans (DFSP) is a soft tissue neoplasm of intermediate malignancy that is initially localized to the skin from where it can invade deep structures (fat, fascia, muscle and bone).

nodes.description: As the tumor grows, it may form a larger soft tissue mass extending into subcutaneous tissues. The tumor has an infiltrative growth pattern.

evidence.reference_title: Metastatic Fibrosarcomatous Transformation of Dermatofibrosarcoma Protuberans With Lung Metastasis: A Case Report.
evidence.snippet: On gross examination, DFSP usually manifests as a white or yellow soft tissue mass with a smooth outer surface and poor circumscription.

nodes.description: Constitutive PDGFR-beta signaling drives sustained proliferation of CD34-positive dermal spindle cells arranged in a storiform pattern. The honeycomb infiltrative growth pattern into underlying subcutaneous adipose tissue explains the high local recurrence rate after incomplete excision and the potential for high-grade fibrosarcomatous progression.

evidence.reference_title: Rare Variants of Dermatofibrosarcoma Protuberans: Clinical, Histologic, and Molecular Features and Diagnostic Pitfalls
evidence.snippet: The classic histomorphology of this tumor is made up of uniform, spindle-shaped cells, arranged in a storiform pattern. Tumor cells characteristically infiltrate the underlying subcutis in a honeycomb pattern.

evidence.reference_title: Metastatic Fibrosarcomatous Transformation of Dermatofibrosarcoma Protuberans With Lung Metastasis: A Case Report.
evidence.snippet: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans (DFSP) is a low- to intermediate-grade dermal soft tissue malignant tumor (sarcoma) with a high local recurrence rate but low metastatic potential.
